sequence_points.name: Triptych of Abstract Forms
sequence_points.description: Three small, horizontally aligned artworks mounted on a light gray wall. The left piece features a blue and white abstract pattern resembling frost or crystalline texture; the center shows a grayscale silhouette of a hand reaching toward a circular shape; the right displays vertical white lines on a light background, evoking motion or sound waves.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Textural Composition
sequence_points.description: A vertically oriented abstract artwork featuring a textured surface with dominant blue and white tones, resembling a close-up of a natural or mineral formation. The piece is mounted on a neutral-colored wall, suggesting a gallery setting.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Line Drawing
sequence_points.description: A minimalist artwork featuring a series of vertical, wavy lines arranged in a rectangular frame against a light background. The composition is simple and monochromatic, with the lines appearing to be drawn or etched in a subtle tone.
